simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כְּסִיל (H3686) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: כְּסִיל (Kᵉçîyl) means Kesil , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 15 30.

definitions.full: H3686. Kesil III. כְּסִיל proper name, of a location in south of tribe of Judah Josh 15:30 , probably corrupt for בְּתוּל 19:4 ; see בְּתוּאֵל .
